pair.no_device: No fan selected. Go back and pick a fan.

auth.title: Authentication code
auth.intro: To control the fan, Homey needs its 4-byte authentication code. Without it the fan can only be read.
auth.step1: Press the power button on the fan, then hold the Bluetooth/WiFi button for 8 seconds until the fan enters pairing mode.
auth.step2: Tap 'Fetch code from fan' within a minute, or type a code you already have (8 hex characters).
auth.need_code: Enter or fetch a code first.

errors.no_auth: An authentication code is required to control the fan. Add it in the device settings or run Repair.
errors.auth_failed: The fan rejected the authentication code. Run Repair to fetch a new one.
errors.no_state: No data from the fan yet.
